steps.instruction: Press 3 sheets of foil into a bowl 5 inches wide and 2 inches deep.
steps.spoken: Place 3 sheets of foil, each about 15 by 15 inches, into a bowl 5 inches across and 2 inches deep. Press the foil gently downward to give it the shape of the bowl.

steps.instruction: Spread 1 tablespoon of butter all over the inside of the foil bowl.
Place 1 slice of ham in the bottom of the foil bowl.
Cut the other slice of ham into three strips.
Line the inside walls of the foil bowl with the ham strips.
Spread 2 tablespoons of canned peas over the eggs.
steps.spoken: Spread 2 tablespoons of canned peas all over the eggs. Be careful with the yolks and don't break them.

steps.instruction: Add 1 teaspoon of the liquid from the can.
Add 1 pinch of salt and 2 tablespoons of ketchup, covering the whole surface.
Carefully lift the foil with the casserole out of the bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup of ground Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the 400 °F oven for 30 minutes.
